schema.description:
[VulnCheck KEV](https://docs.vulncheck.com/community/vulncheck-kev/introduction) is a community catalog of vulnerabilities known to be exploited in the wild. It covers substantially more vulnerabilities than the CISA KEV catalog, and often records exploitation earlier.  

Using it requires a VulnCheck API token. A free community token is sufficient.

apiToken.title: API Token
apiToken.description:
Personal Access Token to authenticate with the GitHub API.  
**The token is only required for authentication and does not require any permissions**.  
Both [fine-grained](https://github.com/settings/personal-access-tokens/new) and [classic](https://github.com/settings/tokens/new) access tokens work.  
Mutually exclusive with the GitHub App credentials.

appId.title: GitHub App ID
appId.description: ID of the GitHub App to authenticate as. Configure together with the Installation ID and App Private Key as an alternative to the API Token.

installationId.title: GitHub App Installation ID
installationId.description: ID of the GitHub App installation to mint access tokens for.

appPrivateKey.title: GitHub App Private Key
appPrivateKey.description: PEM-encoded RSA private key of the GitHub App in PKCS#8 format (`-----BEGIN PRIVATE KEY-----`). GitHub delivers keys in PKCS#1 (`-----BEGIN RSA PRIVATE KEY-----`); convert once with `openssl pkcs8 -topk8 -nocrypt -in github-app.pem -out github-app.pk8.pem`.

enabled.title: Enabled
enabled.description: Whether the JVN (Japan Vulnerability Notes) data source should be enabled.

feedBaseUrl.title: JVN data feed base URL
feedBaseUrl.description: Base URL of the JVN data feeds (the `.../ja/feed` directory). The yearly detail feeds (`detail/jvndb_detail_YYYY.rdf`) and `checksum.txt` are read from here. Defaults to `https://jvndb.jvn.jp/ja/feed`.

startYear.title: Backfill start year
startYear.description: First publication year to mirror from the yearly detail feeds (JVN iPedia data reaches back to 1998). Defaults to 1998.

enabled.title: Enabled
enabled.description: Whether the NVD data source should be enabled.

cveFeedsUrl.title: CVE Feeds URL
cveFeedsUrl.description:
The URL to download CVE feeds from.  
**Must** serve [JSON 2.0 feed files](https://nvd.nist.gov/vuln/data-feeds#divJson20Feeds).

enabled.title: Enabled
enabled.description: Whether the OSV data source should be enabled.

aliasSyncEnabled.title: Alias Synchronization Enabled
aliasSyncEnabled.description: Whether to include alias information in vulnerability data.

incrementalMirroringEnabled.title: Incremental Mirroring Enabled
incrementalMirroringEnabled.description: Whether incremental mirroring is enabled. When enabled (default), watermark logic will be used to only mirror new or updated vulnerabilities. When disabled, full mirroring will be performed on each run.

dataUrl.title: Data URL
dataUrl.description:
The URL to download OSV data from.  
**Must** be compatible with [OSV's data dumps](https://google.github.io/osv.dev/data/#data-dumps).

ecosystems.title: Ecosystems
ecosystems.description:
The ecosystems to mirror vulnerability data for.  
A list of available ecosystems can be found in the [OSV documentation](https://ossf.github.io/osv-schema/#defined-ecosystems).
